ec_conductor.prompt: Print the conductor of the elliptic curve y^2 = x^3 - x over the rationals.

ec_rank.prompt: Print (only) the Mordell-Weil rank of the elliptic curve y^2 = x^3 - 2 over Q.

ec_points_ff.prompt: Print the number of points on the elliptic curve y^2 = x^3 + x + 1 over the finite field GF(101).

nf_class_number.prompt: Print the class number of the imaginary quadratic field Q(sqrt(-23)).

nf_discriminant.prompt: Print the discriminant of the maximal order of the number field defined by x^3 - x - 1.

minpoly_degree.prompt: Print the degree of the minimal polynomial over Q of sqrt(2) + sqrt(3).

ff_factor.prompt: Print the number of distinct irreducible factors of the polynomial x^4 + 1 over GF(3).

grp_gl_order.prompt: Print the order of the general linear group GL(2, GF(3)).

grp_sym_classes.prompt: Print the number of conjugacy classes of the symmetric group S_8.

matrix_det.prompt: Print the determinant of the integer matrix [[2,1,0],[1,2,1],[0,1,2]].

modform_dim.prompt: Print the dimension of the space of weight-12 cusp forms for SL_2(Z) (level 1).

partitions.prompt: Print the number of partitions of the integer 100.

lattice_min.prompt: Print (only) the minimum (squared length of a shortest nonzero vector) of the root lattice E8.

cyclotomic_degree.prompt: Print the degree of the 100th cyclotomic polynomial (i.e. Euler phi of 100).
